description.text: HOPE (Humans over Private Equity) for Homeownership Act

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

bill.title: HOPE (Humans over Private Equity) for Homeownership Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill imposes a 15% excise tax on purchases of newly acquired 1–4 unit single‑family residences by qualifying hedge fund taxpayers and adds a 5‑point corporate surtax plus limits on mortgage interest, depreciation, and QBI benefits. It targets pooled‑fund entities with $50M+ AUM, applies after enactment, and excludes 501(c)(3)s, homebuilders, and owner‑occupied, never‑rented homes.

impact.summary: The bill imposes a 15% excise on purchases of 1–4‑unit homes by "hedge fund taxpayers"—pooled‑investor entities (partnerships, corporations, REITs) with $50,000,000+ AUM. It also adds a 5‑point corporate surtax for those corporations and disallows mortgage‑interest, depreciation, and the 199A qualified business income deduction for hedge‑fund landlords.
